sex.evidence: Eight-week-old male C57BL/6J mice (Beijing SPF Biotechnology...)

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin... was dissolved in sterile 0.9% saline solution and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)... we selected three different drug doses: 0.1 mg/kg, 0.5 mg/kg, and 2.5 mg/kg.

handling.evidence: Prior to FC, all mice were acclimated to the environment and handled for 7 days.

group_housing.evidence: Eight-week-old male C57BL/6J mice... were individually housed

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-12 h light-dark cycle (lights on from 8:00 A. M. to 8:00 P. M.)... All behavioral tests were performed between 9:00 A. M. and 5:00 P. M.

assays.assay_name: Auditory Cued Fear Conditioning and Extinction
assays.assay_description: Auditory cued FC in Context A (5 tone-shock pairings, day-2), psilocybin given 30 min before extinction training (12 CS, Context B, day 0), extinction testing 24 h later (12 CS, Context B), extinction retrieval on day 6 (4 CS, Context B), and fear renewal on day 7 (4 CS, Context A). Primary measure: percentage of freezing time.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) in a volume of 0.1 mL/10 g of mouse body mass

setup_habituation.evidence: Prior to FC, all mice were acclimated to the environment and handled for 7 days (room/handling acclimation, not apparatus pre-exposure).

setup_restrain.evidence: square chamber made of transparent plexiglas with a metal grid floor (freely moving)

food_restriction.evidence: water and food freely available in home cage; no food in FC chamber during testing

water_restriction.evidence: water and food freely available in home cage; no water in FC chamber during testing

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocybin was administered 30 min prior to fear extinction training... fear extinction testing was performed... at 24 h after psilocybin administration... extinction retrieval... on the sixth day... fear renewal... on the seventh day

sample_size.evidence: A hundred of mice were randomly divided into two groups, non-fear-conditioned group (FC(-) Veh, n = 20) and fear-conditioned group (FC(+), n = 80)... n = 20 for each group

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.5 and 2.5 mg/kg) reduced freezing during extinction training; 2.5 mg/kg significantly reduced freezing at 24 h extinction testing, day 6 retrieval, and day 7 renewal, indicating rapid and sustained facilitation of fear extinction.
outcomes.evidence: A single dose of psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg, i.p.) reduced the increase in the percentage of freezing time induced by FC at 24 h, 6th day and 7th day after administration.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The variable of interest was the percentage of time spent freezing relative to the total duration of CS presentation.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Details regarding percentage of freezing time during fear extinction training and fear extinction testing from the first to the last CS presentation are shown in Supplementary Figure 2.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Freezing behavior was defined as the cessation of all movement except respiration and heartbeat (conditioned freezing, not ethological).

B5_social.evidence: No social component in the fear conditioning paradigm.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Fear extinction is a process that involves learning and memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Freezing time was recorded and analyzed by a FC video analysis system (position/motion-based detection).

E1_environment_type.evidence: square chamber made of transparent plexiglas with a metal grid floor... triangular chamber made of non-transparent black and white plexiglas with a flat, solid floor

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter in the conditioning/extinction chambers.

E3_bedding.evidence: metal grid floor... flat, solid floor

E6_spatial.evidence: Each chamber (context A or B) is a single-compartment conditioning chamber.

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice tested individually in the conditioning chambers.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the testing apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: fear extinction testing was performed on the first day; fear extinction retrieval and fear renewal were tested on the sixth and seventh days, respectively

D2_session_duration.evidence: 12 CS presentations (30 s) with ITI 30 s ≈ 12 min for training/testing; FC day = 5 CS-US pairings with 120 s ITI ≈ 12 min; retrieval/renewal = 4 CS with 30 s ITI (~4 min).

D3_recording_days.evidence: FC day (day-2), extinction training (day 0), extinction testing (day 1), retrieval (day 6), renewal (day 7).

D4_baseline.evidence: The baseline percentage of freezing time was not significantly different among the groups (Supplementary Figure 1).

D5_followup.evidence: fear extinction retrieval and fear renewal were tested on the sixth and seventh days, respectively (>=24 h after single dose).

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in the center of a 40 × 40 × 40 cm plastic box, allowed to acclimate for 2 min, then total distance traveled recorded over 5 min using Smart Video Tracing System. Performed 24 h after psilocybin administration.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in the center of a plastic box... allowed to acclimate for 2 min (within-session only); no separate prior apparatus exposure described.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in the center of a plastic box... and allowed to move freely

food_restriction.evidence: No food in OFT apparatus; food ad libitum in home cage.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in OFT apparatus; water ad libitum in home cage.

time_to_assay.evidence: we assessed the total distance traveled by mice in the OFT 24 h after psilocybin administration

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.1, 0.5, 2.5 mg/kg) did not significantly alter total distance traveled in the open field 24 h after administration, indicating that fear-extinction effects were not attributable to changes in locomotor activity.
outcomes.evidence: Different doses of psilocybin had no effect on the total distance traveled (F 3, 76 = 0.957, P = 0.417).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the total distance traveled over the next 5 min was recorded

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total distance over 5 min reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour.

B6_cognitive.evidence: OFT does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed by the Smart Video Tracing System (Smart version 3.0, Panlab) — centroid tracking.

E6_spatial.evidence: plastic box... with a base divided into 16 equal sectors (virtual zones only)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: On the first day, we performed the OFT 2 h before fear extinction testing (single session).

D2_session_duration.evidence: the total distance traveled over the next 5 min was recorded

D3_recording_days.evidence: OFT performed on a single day, 24 h after psilocybin.

D5_followup.evidence: Only one OFT session, at 24 h; no further follow-up OFT.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: (1) Auditory cued fear conditioning + extinction (collapsing FC, extinction training, extinction testing, retrieval, renewal into a single learning paradigm per rubric) and (2) Open Field Test.
B2 for FC scored Yes because the paper explicitly reports per-CS freezing trajectories across the 12 CS presentations within sessions (Supplementary Figure 2) — overriding qwen's No.
D2 for OFT scored 0 (<15 min: 5 min recording + 2 min acclimation) — corrected gptoss which mistakenly scored 1.
D1 for OFT scored 0 (single session); gptoss inconsistently labeled value 'Single session' with score 1.
setup_habituation for the FC assay set to 'no' (handling/room acclimation does not count as apparatus habituation per rubric).
n_total for FC assay set to 100 (includes the FC(-) vehicle non-conditioned control group, n=20, plus 80 fear-conditioned mice across four dose groups).
enrichment_housing left as not_reported (low confidence) since paper is silent on home-cage enrichment.
